# Infiquetra Agent Plugins

> Portable Agent Skills, Agent Plugins, and vendor adapters for Infiquetra engineering workflows.

## Core

- [README](README.md): Human entry point, status, layout, and validation.
- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md): Repository boundaries and required behavior.
- [Documentation index](docs/README.md): Documentation navigation.
- [Architecture brief](docs/cross-vendor-plugin-architecture-brief.md): Research, proposed architecture, compatibility, and open decisions.
- [Engineering journal](docs/engineering-journal/README.md): Durable learnings, decisions, queued work, and archive.
- [Public guidance](docs/public-safe-summary.md): Public-safe Infiquetra development rules.

## Pilot

- [Portability pilot plan](docs/plans/2026-08-21-unifi-fleet-core-portability-pilot-plan.md): The approved plan for the first portability pilot, executed and complete.
- [Ten-client compatibility matrix](docs/evidence/2026-08-22-unifi-compatibility-matrix.md): What every installed coding-agent client did with the portable UniFi package, stage by stage, with evidence. Coverage was mandatory; passing was not.

## Tooling

- [Port descriptors](ports/README.md): One JSON file per portable package, holding its identity, custody table, and assessment settings. The porting tools read it instead of carrying package constants of their own.
- [Porting runbook](docs/runbooks/portable-plugin-port.md): The checklist for porting a plugin into the catalog, derived from the UniFi pilot.

## Packages

- [Mission Control package](plugins/mission-control/README.md): Portable mission-control package for SDLC management, derived from a pinned upstream revision with its Claude adapter under `com.infiquetra.claude/`.
- [UniFi package](plugins/unifi/README.md): Portable UniFi package derived from a pinned upstream revision, with its Claude adapter under `com.infiquetra.claude/`.
- [Fleet Core package](plugins/fleet-core/README.md): Portable Fleet Core source carrying the shared rate-limit retry, intent envelope, and tier palette modules.
- [Deferred Fleet Core modules](plugins/fleet-core/DEFERRED.md): Every upstream module not ported, named explicitly. No document here claims full Fleet Core parity.
- [Site profile contract](plugins/unifi/references/site-profile.md): The optional machine-local operator site profile the UniFi package reads. Absent profile means discovery-only mode and no inferred intent.
